description: The chart illustrates the number of hateful communication datasets per year, separated into two target categories using stacked bars. The horizontal axis contains the categories as years labeled “Year,” running in chronological order from 2012 through 2022 with evenly spaced year ticks. The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and uses a linear scale from 0 up to about 160, with regularly spaced tick marks at 20-unit intervals. Each year is represented by a stacked bar with a blue segment for “Untargeted” and an orange segment for “Targeted,” as indicated by the legend titled “Targets” in the upper-left. Approximate stacked totals by year are: 2012 ~2 (orange only), 2013 ~2 (blue only), 2014 ~3 (orange only), 2015 ~3 (orange only), 2016 ~13 (blue ~4 plus orange ~9), 2017 ~28 (blue ~12 plus orange ~16), 2018 ~48 (blue ~20 plus orange ~28), 2019 ~65 (blue ~12 plus orange ~53), 2020 ~130 (blue ~48 plus orange ~82), 2021 ~160 (blue ~66 plus orange ~94), and 2022 ~37 (blue ~10 plus orange ~27). The bars are not visually emphasized with outlines or annotations beyond the color coding and stacking, and the ordering follows the year sequence rather than sorting by bar height.
